say:1:1536109501:1.text: Of course! Every Wildborn wants to go!
say:1:1536109501:1.source_cn: 当然！每个雅库伯尔人都想去！
say:1:1536109501:1.male: Of course! Every Wildborn wants to go!
say:1:1536109501:1.female: Of course! Every Wildborn wants to go!

say:2:1536109502:1.text: It's one of the rare times to see the Hunting Goddess in the flesh!
say:2:1536109502:1.source_cn: 这可是极少数能见到狩猎神大人的机会啊！
say:2:1536109502:1.male: It's one of the rare times to see the Hunting Goddess in the flesh!
say:2:1536109502:1.female: It's one of the rare times to see the Hunting Goddess in the flesh!

say:3:1536109503:1.text: If my baby weren't on the way... I would've gone too. Just my luck...
say:3:1536109503:1.source_cn: 如果不是我孩子快出生了，我也……唉。
